View courses now

About the University

The University of Portsmouth is the 25th largest in the UK and dates back to the opening of the Portsmouth and Gosport School of Science & Art in 1870. After years as a Polytechnic, it became a university in 1992 and currently has around 28,000 students. More than 4,000 of these are international students from 150 countries around the world.

It offers a range of disciplines, including Pharmacy, International Relations, Mechanical Engineering, Mathematics, Paleontology, Criminology, Criminal Justice and Law. The University of Portsmouth has been ranked as world-leading or internationally excellent for its research facilities.

The University of Portsmouth is developing their campus with a Â£400m Estates Masterplan, featuring refurbishments, redevelopments and new buildings across the campus and city itself, including a brand new BREEAM UK-certified indoor sports centre. Numerous research facilities are used by students everyday on campus, with one of the leading Sports and Exercise departments in the UK. The University is a modern, open space with laptops and PCS for use, ergonomic seating and a wealth of resources for studying towards a chosen degree.

Reasons to choose University of Portsmouth

Student Life

Portsmouth University was ranked as a top 25 university in the UK for student satisfaction according to Times Higher Education, 2023. More than 140 student groups have been set up via the Student Union, including 24 sports clubs. Students can also get involved with the student radio or magazine as a creative outlet. The Fusion Festival occurs annually thanks to the efforts of the Afro-Caribbean Society as part of Black History Month. Events on campus bring students together regularly, whether for networking or socialising purposes.

highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value:
The University of Portsmouth is the 25th largest in the UK and dates back to the opening of the Portsmouth and Gosport School of Science & Art in 1870. Over time, it evolved into a Polytechnic and officially became a university in 1992.

At Portsmouth, you will be joining a diverse community of international students. Around 28,000 students study there, including more than 5,000 international students from over 150 countries. Whether you're interested in Pharmacy, International Relations, Mechanical Engineering, Mathematics, Palaeontology, Criminology, Criminal Justice, or Law, there’s a course that could suit you.

highlights.title: Student Life
highlights.value: The University of Portsmouth was ranked among the top 25 universities in the UK for student satisfaction by Times Higher Education in 2023. So, you can expect a supportive and engaging student experience. Plus, the Students’ Union runs over 140 student groups, including 24 different sports clubs, so whether you're into football, fencing, or photography, there's something for you.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
At the University of Portsmouth, you'll find halls of residence conveniently located near the main campus. You can choose between catered or self-catered options, depending on what suits your lifestyle. Every room comes with the essentials: a bed, desk, drawers, and free WiFi to keep you connected. If you prefer to live off campus, the university can also help you find accommodation in the local area, offering support and advice to make the process easier.

Additionally, if you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
At the university library, you’ll find individual study spaces and study booths, drop-in meeting pods and open-plan seating for study, research and support.

Sports
If you’re into sports, you’ve got loads of options. The university has a variety of sports clubs, with popular choices like Football, Basketball, Rugby, Tennis, Swimming, Rowing, and more.

Laboratory
You’ll have access to many modern laboratories for various disciplines. These include Biophysical Labs, SAP Next Generation Lab, and more.

Cafeteria
You can grab a meal or a coffee at places like Chimes Restaurant, the Library Coffee Shop, Ravelin Sports Centre Café, or the 901 Internet Café, just to name a few.
